issues.jp_before: 朝[あさ]の{電車[でんしゃ]|ym-onkun}はいつも混[こ]んでいます。
issues.problem: Distractor いなずま is an unrelated word (稲妻), not a reading a learner would assemble from 電車.
issues.action: Replaced いなずま with でんくるま.

issues.jp_before: 夏[なつ]の夜[よる]、川[かわ]のそばで{花火[はなび]|ym-onkun}を見[み]ました。
issues.problem: why called 花火 a 'special compound'; it is an ordinary kun compound with rendaku.
issues.action: Rewrote why: kun compound はな + ひ, ひ voiced to び.

issues.jp_before: 夏[なつ]の夜空[よぞら]で{星座[せいざ]|ym-onkun}を探[さが]しました。
issues.problem: 夜空で 探す is unnatural; searching for something in the sky takes に.
issues.action: Changed 夜空で to 夜空に.

issues.jp_before: 今夜[こんや]は{月[つき]|ym-onkun}がとてもきれいですね。
issues.problem: Distractor ぐえつ is not a plausible reading of 月.
issues.action: Replaced ぐえつ with づき (the voiced compound form, wrong alone).

issues.jp_before: 雨[あめ]の日[ひ]は{山道[やまみち]|ym-onkun}があぶないです。
issues.problem: Distractor さんどう is a dictionary reading of 山道 (mountain road), so it is not plainly wrong.
issues.action: Replaced distractors with さんみち, やまどう, ざんみち.
